نتصادم (form VI)
# نَتَصَادَمُ (nataṣādamu) /na.ta.sˤaː.da.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَصَادَمَ (taṣādama)
# نَتَصَادَمَ (nataṣādama) /na.ta.sˤaː.da.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَصَادَمَ (taṣādama)
# نَتَصَادَمْ (nataṣādam) /na.ta.sˤaː.dam/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَصَادَمَ (taṣādama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
